page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 architecture. The server is powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz, providing 8 dedicated vCPUs. It is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. This hardware profile provides stable, non-burstable compute resources without hardware acceleration, as it contains zero GPUs.

Storage and networking configurations follow a modular cloud infrastructure model. The ecs.g9i.2xlarge instance does not include bundled local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of network-attached block storage volumes for persistent data. Its networking layer provides a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps, facilitating predictable data transfer for network-dependent applications. Complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the instance configuration.

The 1:4 processor-to-memory allocation delivers cost efficiency by balancing core execution capability with memory footprint, preventing over-provisioning for symmetrical workloads. Because the instance provides dedicated physical processor execution without bursting penalties, it is suitable for medium-scale enterprise applications, relational and key-value database engines, backend web serving tiers, and continuous integration pipelines.
